cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The car won't start. Excellent chance for a walk. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And a free shower!

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brilliant. The shower's finally reached your feet.

mechanism: A confidently leads through setbacks by growing more optimistic while accepting B practical limits and preferences to keep the partnership moving.
confusable: Distinguish insensitive positive slogans from optimism that changes A cooperative plan; no claim the bad facts disappear.
comparison: Car/rain/leaking shoe reframing must include adaptive route or pace; failed show and lost deposit must adapt to B homeward choice as a creative opportunity.
seedUse: D20-single-a is a protected unresolved historical single: use its car/rain/shoe seed critically without clearing its exception. Read D20-b theatre/bus and S02 yielding-leadership seeds independently.
